An asterisk (*) marks a date on a weekend with no published rule or on a public holiday, so another date may be announced. The "pensions, SANED and social security" column covers all three because they share one rule. Early payment before Eid is a one-off decision announced at the time.

Frequently asked questions

What are the monthly payment dates in Saudi Arabia?

Pensions, SANED and developed social security on the 1st, Hafiz on the 5th, the Citizen's Account on the 10th, housing support on the 24th, the disability allowance on the 26th and government salaries on the 27th, all Gregorian.

When are GOSI pensions paid?

On the 1st of each Gregorian month since May 2024 for civil, military and GOSI pensioners, moved to the Thursday before when the 1st is a Friday or Saturday.
